drhp.business: Sheetal Cool Products Limited is a diversified food products company with a strong presence across major states of India and a growing international presence across markets including the USA, Japan, Australia, Hong Kong, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, Congo, South Korea, Mauritius and Bhutan. The company's diversified product portfolio and established distribution network cater to a wide range of consumer preferences across multiple food categories, spanning ice cream, namkeen, milk products, bakery, sweets and ready-to-eat/ready-to-cook offerings.

sk.overview: India is the world's largest milk producer, contributing ~26% of global milk production in CY25, and the Indian dairy market is stated at INR 12.0T in FY26 within a packaged food market of INR 15.8T and an F&B market of INR 74.0T. risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Exposed to fluctuations in prices of key raw materials, dairy inputs, agricultural commodities and packaging materials; changes in commodity prices, supply-demand conditions, climatic factors and vendor pricing may impact production costs and profitability.
- Unpredictable weather patterns and climate-related events may affect the availability and pricing of agricultural and dairy inputs and may also influence consumer demand and supply-chain operations, particularly for seasonal products such as ice cream.
- Operates in a competitive market comprising established national brands as well as regional and local players; increased competition may result in pricing pressure and may impact market share.
- Segment Reporting under Ind AS 108 is not applicable since the Company operates in only one segment, leaving it structurally exposed to a downturn across its entire product range rather than diversified across reportable segments.
- Cautionary statement flags global and domestic demand and supply conditions affecting selling prices, input availability and prices, changes in government regulations and tax laws, and economic/political developments as factors that could cause actual results to differ materially.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Continued product innovation, geographical expansion and strengthening of the distribution network
- Increasing focus on milk and milk-based products
- Expansion of export business into overseas markets
- Improvement in manufacturing and operational efficiencies
- Enhancing operational efficiencies and leveraging technology to improve coordination across business functions
- Addressing competitive and input-cost challenges through product diversification, efficient procurement practices, strengthening of the distribution network, product innovation and cost optimisation
